_notes: Example: Kaylee's weekday US-market morning briefing, re-expressed as a podcast-kit show.json.
No hosting details here: REPO_DIR/BASE_URL/SECRET live only in the show folder's config.env (chmod 600).

Her live setup currently serves this show AND What's News from ONE combined feed. To reproduce that exactly, merge both into one show.json using episode.types (see kaylee-whats-news.json); as separate shows each gets its own feed.

music.style 'news' is the kit's re-synthesised newsroom preset (D minor, like Caster's original 116 BPM jingle). To keep Caster's exact sound instead, set music.files to copies of its intro/sting/outro/bed wav files.
title: Kaylee 美股晨间新闻
subtitle: 每个工作日早上，用故事和逻辑讲清楚昨晚的美股
author: Kaylee 美股晨间新闻
description: 私人订阅，仅供个人收听。每个工作日早上更新的美股晨间新闻：两位主播用故事和因果逻辑讲清楚昨晚华尔街发生的事。AI撰稿与配音。

hosts.name: 主播A
hosts.role: male anchor, leads the big stories

hosts.name: 主播B
hosts.role: female co-host: snapshot, natural follow-up questions, watchlist

schedule.notes: Kaylee listens while driving; covers the previous US session.

sources.name: Bloomberg
sources.notes: Kaylee's subscription via the browser; prefer Big Take / Features / Businessweek / analysis for the in-depth segment

sources.name: Public news sites
sources.notes: public reporting for facts and confirmation (name the outlet on air)

segments.name: Cold open
segments.what: A, one line with the day's 1-2 headlines, ending 「这里是Kaylee美股晨间新闻。」 then [INTRO]

segments.name: Greeting + rundown
segments.what: A greets and lists the 3-4 stories, B says hi; [BED ON] for a 2-3 sentence market mood (direction, no figures), [BED OFF]

segments.name: Main stories (2-3, in depth)
segments.what: each starts with [STING]: what happened -> backstory / cause -> who wins and loses -> what it means for the stocks; alternate A/B, B asks the natural follow-up the facts answer

segments.name: In-depth segment
segments.what: at least one long-term trend from Bloomberg investigative/analysis pieces, why it matters for years, not days

segments.name: Watchlist + recap + sign-off
segments.what: [STING], what to watch today/this week, 3-4 point recap, A signs off, B 「我们明天早上见。」, [OUTRO]

format.tone: Natural spoken Mandarin for a commute; story and cause-and-effect over data. People, places, companies, tickers, index and product names stay in English.
rules: NUMBERS: 「我要的是故事和逻辑性，不是一个个数据」. Replace percentages and figures with meaning and scale in words; at most ~1 number per story and only when it is the point. No index levels, lists of percentages, tables or futures figures.
Fact vs analysis: confirmed facts name their source (根据S-1 / WSJ报道 / Bloomberg报道); analysis is labelled (「这是我们的分析，不是已经证实的事实」).

Prioritise: big-tech AI strategy/spending/risk as business stories; industry insider stories (Musk/SpaceX/Tesla, Anthropic, OpenAI, who pays whom, power struggles); oil and geopolitics and their knock-on effects; China's structural shifts and capital flows; big consumer M&A; scandals, hacks, halts and drama; big-picture Fed/macro commentary.
De-prioritise or skip: market-wrap and sentiment pieces, bond/credit/options technicals, plain earnings results, small caps, quirky items, earnings calendars.
Long-term value over daily noise: daily price moves get at most a sentence; don't build a main story around 'X fell today' unless the cause is a lasting shift.
Prosody: A(-3%..-5%) for serious/caveat lines, (+2%..+4%,+1..+2Hz) for questions/lighter turns; nothing bigger.
Delivery: link the published episode; never attach the MP3.
